svg.title: Plogger three-factor chart (phone)
svg.desc: A chart of all thirteen intervals showing the historic Plogger three-factor glyph for [1] to [11] and N/A for the unison and octave, each with its shape, shadow and fill named, and a legend.

g.text: HOW TO READ THE THREE PLOGGER MARKS
